lede: Nvidia is the one story the feeds tell together today. The AI news wire opens on Jensen Huang's exit as Nvidia's CEO, several of its top headlines turning on who succeeds him, while Polymarket prices only an 11 percent chance he rejoins the company by December 31 and Wikipedia logs the interest. Away from that, Robert Pattinson led the encyclopedia with 1,363,657 views, about 2.5 times the runner-up, a magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck near Tual, Indonesia, and Counter-Strike 2 held 1,089,270 players on Steam.

throughlines.title: Robert Pattinson
throughlines.gist: Led Wikipedia by a wide margin and showed up on YouTube the same day, which pulled him across two unrelated feeds at once.

throughlines.title: Will Jensen Huang rejoin NVIDIA by December 31, 2026?
throughlines.gist: The news wire is working through Nvidia's succession while the betting market puts his return by year end near 11 percent, a story now spanning news, markets, and the encyclopedia.

throughlines.title: NBA 2K27 x GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto 6) - Official Vice City Crossover Trailer
throughlines.gist: Anticipation for Grand Theft Auto VI surfaced on Steam, YouTube, and Wikipedia at the same time.
